title: The Year Everything Was Measured
subtitle: 未来展望 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 未来展望（宇宙探索·未来与展望）
meta: 主题语境：未来展望（宇宙探索·未来与展望）　|　核心词汇：standard　|　正文 353 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 standard 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 2031, according to the plan pinned to our classroom wall, every child would be taught by a machine and no child would be taught badly. I was eleven and I believed it. The ① standard the plan promised was not higher teaching but a ② standard one — the same lesson, the same hour, the same test — and I have spent the years since deciding whether those are the same thing.

The machines came, slowly and expensively, and with them a ③ standard of measurement nobody had asked for. Every answer was logged; every pause was timed. What the logs could not record was whether anybody had been taught anything, and so a new ④ standard was invented: engagement, which meant, in practice, that a child who looked at the screen for eleven minutes was counted as taught. The standard, everyone agreed, had improved; nobody could say what it had improved against.

My own teacher, Mrs Adeyemi, refused it for two years. She set a different ⑤ standard in her room: every child would write one paragraph a week in their own handwriting and she would read all thirty-one. It was not ⑥ standard practice and it was not efficient, and by the measure pinned to the wall she was failing. Her ⑦ standard of living, meanwhile, was a bus pass and a thermos, and she had never once mentioned either.

In the fourth year the council inspected. The software was ⑧ up to standard in every respect — attendance logged, paragraphs scanned, targets met — and the report said so in eleven places. Mrs Adeyemi's class was not, because thirty-one handwritten paragraphs are not a ⑨ standard anyone can audit. She was moved to a smaller room and given fewer hours.

I teach now, in the same building, with the same software. ⑩ The standard I am judged by is a number on a screen and the standard I keep is one I cannot prove. That gap, I have concluded, is not a defect in the system but the definition of the job: the measurable part is what the machine is for, and the rest is what I am for.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 标准；水平；水准
B. n. （道德、行为的）准则；操守
C. adj. 标准的；统一的；常规的
D. adj. 权威的；公认的（standard practice/work）
E. 固定搭配：a standard of measurement 度量标准
F. 固定搭配：up to standard 达到标准；合格
G. 固定搭配：standard of living 生活水平
H. n. 规范；准则（可被审计、检查的）

items.q: a standard of measurement nobody had asked for
She set a different standard in her room
The software was up to standard
not a standard anyone can audit
The standard I am judged by

answers.why: 指规划所承诺的“水准、水平”，说它未必更高。
standard 作形容词，意为“统一的、标准的”，即所有人都一样的一节课。
a standard of measurement 意为“度量标准”，指随之而来的那套量化办法。
指新发明出来的“标准”：engagement（参与度）。
指她自己立下的“准则、操守”，与官方标准不同。
standard practice 意为“常规做法、公认做法”，说她的做法并不属于常规。
standard of living 意为“生活水平”，指一张公交卡和一只保温杯。
up to standard 意为“达到标准、合格”，说软件各项都合格。
指可被审计的“规范、准则”，说手写段落无法被审计。
指用来评判“我”的“标准”，即屏幕上的一个数字。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 规划承诺的标准不是更高的教学，而是统一的教学。（standard）
随之而来的是一套没人要的度量标准。（a standard of measurement）
这在她的教室里并非常规做法。（standard practice）
她的生活水平只是一张公交卡和一只保温杯。（standard of living）
软件在各方面都达到了标准。（up to standard）
三十一段手写文字不是任何人能审计的规范。（standard）

With them came a standard of measurement nobody had asked for.
It was not standard practice in her classroom.
Her standard of living was a bus pass and a thermos.
The software was up to standard in every respect.
Thirty-one handwritten paragraphs are not a standard anyone can audit.
